objective: Test whether direct, indirect and hyperdirect modulation, together with dopamine-like adaptive confidence control, reduces overfitting, underfitting, slowing, oscillation and underperformance while improving accuracy targeting.

dopamine_like_interpretation.absence: insufficient facilitation, slow adaptation, underfitting and persistent underperformance
dopamine_like_interpretation.reduction: delayed candidate recruitment, conservative gating and reduced accuracy targeting
dopamine_like_interpretation.balance: stable confidence updating, appropriate facilitation and inhibition
dopamine_like_interpretation.excess: over-facilitation, excessive candidate persistence, overfitting and unstable switching

evidence_boundary: The dopamine-like variable is a computational modulation parameter inspired by biological function. It is not a clinical or biological simulation claim. No performance claim is valid until the experiment is executed and exact artefacts are preserved.
